notes.title: Twin Mirror’s soundtrack is now available!
notes.content:
DONTNOD is delighted to announce that the Twin Mirror’s evocative original soundtrack is available now in several digital formats: WAV (digital mastering), MP3 (48K Hz / 320kb/s), and FLAC. 
Created by the award-winning composer David Wingo, Twin Mirror: Soundtrack contains all the tracks created especially for the game Twin Mirror.   

The digital soundtrack is available on the link below on various streaming platforms!  

Listen to the soundtrack now!

 
This atmospheric soundtrack will transport you to the streets of Basswood to relive the thrilling story of Sam Higgs and his relentless pursuit of the truth. Wingo marries dramatic, nail-biting instrumentals typical of the thriller, with soft, ambient moments of reprieve—a must-have for fans of the game.
